convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for the DigitalF-T01 custom indicator and includes external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for trade execution logic (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose). The custom indicator buffers and crossover logic can be replicated but require manual reconstruction of the DigitalF-T01 algorithm.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal timestamp
derived_values.used_by: BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen signal time parameter

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: Signal-based close: Buy position closed when Osc1[1]<Osc2[1] (short crossover confirmed) if BuyPosClose=true; Sell position closed when Osc1[1]>Osc2[1] (long crossover confirmed) if SellPosClose=true

params.mode: LOT or risk_percent selectable via MMMode enum

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum selects between LOT (fixed lot size, MM interpreted as lot count) and risk-based margin mode; MM=0.1 means either 0.1 lots or 0.1 fraction depending on MMMode

custom_logic_notes: Signal detection uses previous bar comparison (index [1]) to confirm crossover direction, then checks current bar (index [0]) for the actual cross event. Specifically: Long entry requires Osc1[1]>Osc2[1] (prev bar bullish) AND Osc1[0]<Osc2[0] (current bar bearish cross from above) — this appears to be a MEAN REVERSION entry where a temporary dip below the opposite line triggers a buy, not a trend-following crossover. Similarly for shorts. The SignalBar input (default=1) offsets which bar is read, so signals are generated on the previous completed bar. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean toggles allowing independent enable/disable of each trade direction. The Recount flag triggers recalculation on first tick or after CopyBuffer failure.
python_conversion_notes: The DigitalF-T01 custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python. It uses two buffers (Osc1/Osc2) with a halfchanel parameter (default 25) and an applied price enum (1-11 including custom price types like TrendFollow and Demark). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar) need Python equivalents. The entry logic is counter-intuitive — it enters long when Osc1 crosses BELOW Osc2 from a previously above state, suggesting mean-reversion not trend-following. SL/TP values (1000/2000) are in points and likely need digit-adjustment (divide by 10 for 5-digit brokers) depending on how the TradeAlgorithms library handles _Point vs pips.
